name: ranchhand
summary: Multi-tenant Slack assistant. Hire it, connect your own Slack workspace, and it answers @mentions and DMs with conversation memory — your workspace credentials stay under your account, released only to your own credential-proxy actor.

proxy.description: hirer's deployed slackrelay proxy actor address (0x…)

state_volume.description: per-hire CBFS state volume name (provisioned by the creator at connect time)

webhooks.description: Slack Events API request URL (all tenants share it; routing is by team_id). Point your Slack app's event subscription here.
webhooks.authentication: Slack v0 HMAC, verified runner-side against YOUR signing secret via your credential proxy (CIP-24 §5.5); the listed actor never holds it.

hirer_setup.description: Post-hire onboarding (scripted by connect-workspace.sh): create a Slack app from the provided manifest, store RANCHHAND_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET + RANCHHAND_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN as CBSS secrets under your account, deploy your slackrelay proxy (manifest names exactly those two keys), ACL both secrets to the proxy, then call connect_workspace.
